captions.detailed: An e-bike torque-sensing crankset featuring a wide, dark cylindrical bottom-bracket shell that houses the internal spindle. On each side, a dark grey crank arm is attached; one arm connects directly to a large, light grey, multi-toothed chainring with rectangular cutouts. Small cylindrical pedal spindles extend outward from the tips of both crank arms. The main spindle, chainring, and both crank arms rotate continuously about the horizontal bottom-bracket axis, while each pedal spindle rotates about its own offset axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a parametric e-bike torque-sensing crankset assembly. It must feature a dark cylindrical bottom-bracket shell, a central rotating spindle, a large light-grey chainring with stylized teeth and cutouts, and two dark-grey crank arms extending in opposite directions. Include continuous rotational joints for the main spindle/crank assembly and for the pedal spindles at the ends of the crank arms.
captions.factory: The code defines an ArticulatedObject and constructs its components using CadQuery primitives. The bottom-bracket shell is built as a central cylinder. The spindle is modeled as a smaller concentric cylinder passing through the shell. The chainring is constructed with a thin cylinder, stylized teeth arrayed radially, and rectangular cutouts. The crank arms are created using lofted or extruded profiles that taper from the spindle attachment to the pedal eye, oriented 180 degrees apart. Finally, continuous articulations are defined for the spindle rotation relative to the shell, and for the pedal spindles relative to each crank arm.
